verdict.rationale: The 2FAS Auth browser extension pairs with the phone and delivers 2FA tokens into the sign-in tab after mobile confirmation, so you 'don't have to retype anything'. Separately, 2FAS Pass offers browser-extension autofill, also confirmed on the phone. However, nothing in the evidence shows passkey support, and every fill depends on a phone confirmation. Missing for 10: any evidence of passkey autofill, independent hands-on corroboration of TOTP autofill, fill that works without a phone round-trip.
